print('desc head:', (d.get('description') or '')[:600])
subs=d.get('automatic_captions') or {}
# try en-orig first (source language ASR)
for lang in ['en-orig','en']:
  items=subs.get(lang) or []
  by={x['ext']:x['url'] for x in items}
  for ext in ['json3','srv3','vtt','ttml']:
    url=by.get(ext)
    if not url: continue
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
      'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
      'Accept-Language':'en-US,en;q=0.9',

    try:

    print(lang, ext, 'bytes', len(data))

      open(f'/tmp/js-{lang}.{ext}','wb').write(data)
      if ext=='json3':
        j=json.loads(data)
        events=j.get('events') or []
        texts=[]
        for ev in events:
          for seg in (ev.get('segs') or []):
            t=seg.get('utf8','')
            if t and t!='\n': texts.append(t)

        # normalize
        body=re.sub(r'\s+',' ', body)
        open('/tmp/js-transcript.txt','w').write(body)
        print('transcript chars', len(body))
        print(body[:2000])
      else:
        print(data[:800])
      raise SystemExit
